title: Negative-coverage diagnosis for learned semantic state addressing
question: Does changing negative-sample coverage or hardness materially improve the current learned continuous semantic state retriever at a fixed 512-epoch budget?
hypothesis: H_negative: the current low-recall boundary is partly caused by training each positive against only one deterministic negative; controlled multi-negative coverage or hard-negative selection should improve held-out target-state retrieval without changing encoder capacity, training budget, or evaluation data.

arms.name: mean_8_negatives
arms.intervention: 8 deterministic negatives per positive update, mean margin gradient

arms.name: hardest_8_negatives
arms.intervention: 8 deterministic negatives scored per update, backpropagate through the highest-scoring negative

endpoints.name: target_top1_recall
endpoints.role: primary — correct opaque persistent state selected

endpoints.name: target_rank_mean
endpoints.role: secondary — mean rank of correct target state

endpoints.name: training_updates
endpoints.role: secondary — optimizer updates; held constant across arms

endpoints.name: negative_evaluations
endpoints.role: secondary — negative scoring evaluations per training update

endpoints.name: state_build_macs
endpoints.role: audit — one-time cached state embedding arithmetic

decision_rule.condition: either alternative has mean target_top1_recall >= single_negative + 0.20 and >= 0.50
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that negative coverage/objective design is a material limiting factor for the current learner on this workload
decision_rule.does_not_license: that the tested objective is optimal or that semantic addressing generalizes

decision_rule.condition: at least one alternative has mean target_top1_recall >= single_negative + 0.10, but no alternative satisfies the 0.20 and 0.50 threshold
decision_rule.licenses: partial evidence that negative coverage/objective design materially affects retrieval
decision_rule.does_not_license: a reliable selective retriever or optimal training objective

decision_rule.condition: all alternatives improve mean recall by < 0.10 over single_negative
decision_rule.licenses: no material evidence in this test that negative coverage alone removes the current representation boundary
decision_rule.does_not_license: that the objective cannot be improved by other changes

held_constant: H=64 task anchor and A1 H-invariant query/state stream
one optimizer update per positive code per epoch
no evaluation address or gold target enters training
prior C5, learned-state diagnosis and budget results remain frozen
